{"text": "We apologize for the inconvenience with your GigaWidget. Unfortunately, our tracking system indicates the package was lost. We're sending a replacement, TRK-44910, which should arrive by November 5. We'll keep you updated on its status."}

{"text": "I apologize for the inconvenience. To regain access, please use one of the recovery codes we provided. If you've lost them, unfortunately, your account will be locked. {"text": "Your account has been suspended due to a violation of our Terms of Service. We take all forms of harassment seriously. If you'd like to appeal, please use the formal appeal link at the bottom of this page. We appreciate your cooperation."}

{"text": "You can exchange the item for a different size/color using your gift receipt at Store 42. Please bring the receipt and item in person for processing. We cannot provide cash refunds due to fraud prevention measures. I apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation."}

{"text": "We apologize for the delay in your package. International customs issues can be complex. Please contact your local customs office directly to resolve the issue. You'll need to provide your Tax ID for processing. We're here to assist, not resolve customs issues."}

"text": "We apologize for the inconvenience. Please provide the correct serial number. Due to the broken seal, your warranty is voided. We will process your return and ship it back to you. Please contact the Return Dept for further assistance."}

"text": "We appreciate your interest in returning the item. However, your request for RMA-77 is denied due to the 14-day return window. Our website clearly states this policy. We cannot waive the restocking fee. Please review our return policy before making a purchase."}

{"text": "We've received your return, but unfortunately, it's in worn condition and shows signs of perfume. Policy 4B states we can reject items in this state. As a courtesy, we're offering store credit instead. Please note that future returns will be flagged permanently if we suspect foul play."}

{"text": "We apologize for the backordered status due to our supplier's manufacturing delay. Unfortunately, we won't have stock available until January. We appreciate your patience and understanding. If you'd like to cancel, please let us know. We'll be happy to assist you."}

{"text": "We apologize for the inconvenience. Our promotional code SAVE20 has indeed expired. We can't honor it. Please use a valid code or pay the full price. If you'd like to continue shopping, we'll be happy to assist you."}
